name: Native Research
description: Requested by: Dr. Carlo. Escort a researcher through the valley, wetlands, and snowfield to conduct a wildlife survey across all three biomes.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: These creatures are far more aggressive than the old field reports indicated. Interesting.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: They attacked without any provocation. That's not normal territorial behavior.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: Most wildlife only fights when cornered. These are seeking us out.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: I've documented everything I need from the valley. Let's move on to the wetlands and see if the pattern holds.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: Same aggression here, even in a completely different ecosystem. This isn't isolated to one species.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: The growth patterns are unusual too. These creatures are mature, but the population density is too high for natural reproduction.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: Something is accelerating their development. I'm not sure what yet.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: Two biomes, same abnormal behavior. One more area should give me enough data to start forming a hypothesis.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: Even here in the snowfield. Whatever is causing this, it's not limited to one region.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: The aggression is consistent across all three biomes. The old research team's notes didn't mention anything like this.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: Either it started after they lost funding, or they never got far enough to notice.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: Wait, look at these rabbits. They're not attacking us.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: Every other creature across three biomes has been hostile on sight. But these are completely calm.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: This wasn't what I expected to find, but it might be more valuable than the survey itself.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: If I can figure out why these rabbits are unaffected, it could explain what's driving the aggression in everything else.

dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
dialog.text: I'm going to collect a sample. Let's head back to the lab. I have a lot of work ahead of me.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Principal
briefing_dialog.text: This is a research assignment. Dr. Carlo from the Pioneer Lab has requested an escort.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
briefing_dialog.text: I'm conducting a wildlife survey across three biomes: valley, wetlands, and snowfield.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
briefing_dialog.text: Research Team 4 was doing similar work before their funding was cut. I want to pick up where they left off.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Principal
briefing_dialog.text: The field is dangerous. Dr. Carlo will need protection while he works.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Dr. Carlo
briefing_dialog.text: I won't slow you down. I just need time to observe and document. That's all I ask.

briefing_dialog.speaker: Principal
briefing_dialog.text: Keep Dr. Carlo safe across all three areas. Good luck out there.
